comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: 19 programs in the process of being reviewed across 6 TVET institutions based on Horticulture-related teaching programs which are currently being offered.

title.narrative: A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: 14 TVET staff members have been involved in interactive online webinars regarding the curriculum review and development approaches. Formal training schedules to be conducted. Due to Covid some face to face trainings could not be held, resulting in less than projected participants.

title.narrative: A.S.4. Number of SMEs supported

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: 44 organizations were involved in the Labour market needs assessment. Covid prohibited additional face-to-face contact as of Q1 2020, limiting the total number of SME’s that could be involved and supported

title.narrative: A.S.5. Number of improvements in (inter)national policies/laws

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: Although discussions were held with legislative authorities that have major influence in policies and laws, including with DHET, Agriseta, EWseta and QCTO, the national lockdown due to Covid resulted in 1) organizations putting their focus on other institutional priority areas, and 2) TVET management putting other priorities for staff and students-related priorities.

title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: Infrastructure assessments (for online teaching and practical training facilities) were completed in the Q4 of year 1. Investments and placement of equipment at 5 TVETs will commence within Q1 of year 2.

- Includes TVET institutions that upgraded online learning instrastructure and environment (5 institutions) - 3 institutions (Northern Cape, Vhembe and Elsenburg) have improved practical training facilities
One further institution to have upgraded online learning infrastructure

title.narrative: A.S.2. Number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: One MOU and one Service Level Agreement (SLA) is in the process of being formulated and signed between SU and Agriseta. Covid caused delaying additional face to face meetings that would lead to additional MoUs.

title.narrative: A.O.2. Number of organisations revised/developed and implemented a strategic plan

comment.narrative: 17-03-2021: SU is currently supporting Nkangala TVET college to implement a strategic plan to develop and better align their education offering with labour market needs and demands. Similar discussion is held between the Northern Cape Rural TVET and project partner AEL on a strategic plan.
